providers.access: Public demo covers selected active symbols. Full delisted-inclusive testing needs an account and the EOD Historical Data All World plan.
providers.price_observation: Personal monthly price displayed as USD 19.99; 100,000 calls/day, 1,000/minute and 30+ years are displayed for the EOD plan. Recheck immediately before purchase.
providers.license_observation: Personal non-commercial storage/analysis only; redistribution/display is prohibited, payments are non-refundable, and the published terms require deletion within one month after expiry.
providers.verdict: Plausible low-cost research archive, not audit-grade: pre-2018 delisted securities have EOD only and the identity/action gaps remain unobserved on the 36-security sample.

raw_ohlcv.limitation: The endpoint documents daily OHLCV, but only AAPL was observed through the public demo.

open_close_semantics.limitation: Open is labelled opening price and close is labelled unadjusted closing price; auction/SIP construction is not specified.

adjusted_close.limitation: Adjusted close is documented as split-and-dividend adjusted; it is never accepted as contemporaneous raw price.

adjustment_method.limitation: The event classes are stated, but exact formula, revision policy and as-of anchoring are not documented.

splits.limitation: Documented for post-2018 delistings; pre-2018 delisted securities explicitly have EOD only.

dividends.limitation: Documented for post-2018 delistings; pre-2018 delisted securities explicitly have EOD only.

listing_date.limitation: Exchange symbol lists are documented, but the public demo did not permit sample-wide lifecycle validation.

delisting_date.limitation: Delisted discovery is documented; precise field coverage remains credential-gated for the sample.

delisting_reason.limitation: The public contract describes delisted availability but does not promise a structured delisting reason.

historical_exchange_security_type.limitation: Current/delisted lists expose exchange and type filters, not a complete dated exchange/type history.

identifier_mapping.limitation: Symbol, ISIN, FIGI, LEI, CUSIP and CIK are documented, but validity dates are absent and the demo returned HTTP 403.

ticker_validity_intervals.limitation: US rename history has old/new symbol and date, while recycled-symbol handling and complete historical coverage remain unverified.

providers.access: A free personal key is registered as a GitHub Actions secret and is documented at 25 requests/day. A paced credentialed probe returned valid active and delisted snapshots; no purchase was required.
providers.price_observation: No purchase is required for the listing-status feasibility check; adjusted daily price history is a separate premium function and is not the selected historical archive.
providers.license_observation: The published grant is personal and non-commercial unless otherwise agreed in writing; raw responses are therefore not committed or redistributed.
providers.verdict: Useful date-specific active/delisted universe input after 2010, with 24/36 awkward samples matched. It is not a security master: OTC and pre-2010 cases were absent, two recycled symbols matched both snapshots, and permanent identifiers, delisting reasons and explicit ticker validity intervals are absent.

raw_ohlcv.limitation: Raw time series are documented elsewhere in the service but were outside this lifecycle probe and not sample-tested.

open_close_semantics.limitation: The listing-status endpoint has no price fields and does not establish auction/open construction.

adjusted_close.limitation: Daily adjusted history is documented as premium and was not acquired or probed.

adjustment_method.limitation: Support states OHLCV adjustment for splits and cash dividends, but no as-of revision contract is stated.

splits.limitation: A splits endpoint is documented but was not observed on this sample.

dividends.limitation: A dividends endpoint is documented but was not observed on this sample.

listing_date.limitation: The paced credentialed sample observed listing dates for 24/36 cases. Coverage was 0/4 for OTC-moved and 0/4 for the deliberately pre-2010 delisting cases.

delisting_date.limitation: The paced credentialed sample observed a delisting date for 7/36 cases. A missing match is a measured gap, not proof that the security never existed.

delisting_reason.limitation: The documented CSV schema has status and date but no reason.

historical_exchange_security_type.limitation: Exchange and assetType were observed for the same 24/36 matched cases, but changes between snapshots are not explicit events.

identifier_mapping.limitation: The listing CSV has no CIK, ISIN, FIGI, CUSIP or permanent security identifier.

ticker_validity_intervals.limitation: Date snapshots can support membership checks but do not directly link renamed or recycled tickers into validity intervals.

providers.access: No self-serve individual price is published. CRSP states that its databases are delivered to academic institutions, government agencies and investment practitioners through a subscription request.
providers.price_observation: Quote/institutional access is required; no spend or sales contact was initiated.
providers.license_observation: Professional licensed source; payload access, retention and redistribution terms require a separate written contract review.
providers.verdict: Strong audit candidate for permanent security identity, corporate actions and delistings, but access is institutional and the documented daily file does not by itself supply a full opening-price OHLCV series.

raw_ohlcv.limitation: Daily price/returns/volume are documented, but a daily opening field is not present in the reviewed CIZ contract.

open_close_semantics.limitation: DlyPrc is last regular-day trade or bid/ask average when unavailable; no opening-auction field is documented.

adjusted_close.limitation: Cumulative adjustment factors and returns are supplied rather than a vendor adjusted-close column.

adjustment_method.limitation: Price/share factors, distributions and total/price/income returns are documented in detail.

splits.limitation: Distribution events include factors for price and shares; actual sample coverage needs licensed access.

dividends.limitation: Ex, declaration, record and payment dates plus amounts are documented; sample coverage needs licensed access.

listing_date.limitation: Security begin/end dates and dated name-history records are documented.

delisting_date.limitation: Delisting date, last price, next price, amount and delisting return are documented.

historical_exchange_security_type.limitation: Dated name-history records include exchange, security status, share class and share/type codes.

identifier_mapping.limitation: PERMNO/PERMCO and dated CUSIP/ticker history are documented; CIK, ISIN and FIGI are not promised.

ticker_validity_intervals.limitation: Permanent security identifiers and dated name/ticker history are core fields; sample coverage needs licensed access.
